Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:

  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;

title: Technical Sales Manager (Master Brewer)
description:
About the role

The Brewing Specialist will lead technical and customer-driven initiatives to support innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings in the alcoholic beverage sector, with a strong focus on beer brewing. This role is responsible for building strategic client relationships, driving adoption of Kerry technologies, and aligning with cross-functional teams to deliver excellence across LATAM.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead with technical insights and leverage customer/consumer feedback to drive innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings.
  • Align with the RDA (Research, Development & Applications) team to ensure cross-functional excellence and consistent ways of working.
  • Own and manage the overall relationship with assigned clients, including onboarding, implementation, and increasing adoption of Kerry technologies.
  • Establish a high level of customer intimacy and build trusted, strategic relationships to drive continued value.
  • Develop and maintain customer success strategies and share best practices across commercial teams.
  • Ensure alignment with Kerry’s alcoholic beverage strategy in LATAM, with a specific focus on beer brewing.
  • Travel to client sites across LATAM at least 70% of the time to support implementation, relationship building, and technical collaboration.

Qualifications and skills

  • Degree in Brewing Science, Fermentation Science, Food Science, or a related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a commercial brewing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of brewing equipment, ingredients, and techniques.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance and laboratory testing procedures.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required.
  • Strong communication, strategic planning, and project management skills.
  • Analytical and process-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working across multiple departments in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Active team player, self-starter, and multitasker with the ability to quickly adjust priorities.
  • Passion for craft beer and innovation.
  • Skilled at developing and delivering compelling stories to clients and stakeholders.
  • Certification from recognized brewing institutions (e.g., Cicerone, IBD) (Desirable)
  • Experience with sustainable brewing practices (Desirable)
  • Knowledge of local and international beer styles (Desirable)

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Product Designer - Sênior
description:
PRODUCT DESIGNER

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Product Designer, você será responsável por conduzir processos de Discovery e Design de Experiência, transformando problemas complexos em soluções intuitivas, consistentes e centradas no usuário. Sua missão será conectar estratégia, dados e usabilidade para desenhar produtos digitais que gerem impacto real para o negócio e para as pessoas.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir processos de Discovery, aplicando metodologias como benchmark, canvas, pesquisas com usuários, testes de usabilidade, análises heurísticas e hierarquia da informação para propor e definir jornadas consistentes;
  • Criar o layout de fluxos de navegação e comunicações a serem apresentados no site, desenhar wireframes, protótipos interativos e interfaces visuais responsiva;
  • Garantir consistência visual, de informação e de usabilidade em todos os produtos digitais;
  • Participar de agendas colaborativas com times de produto, tecnologia e dados, alinhando objetivos estratégicos;
  • Contribuir para a evolução e manutenção do design system da empresa.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência comprovada como UX/UI Designer, com portfólio relevante;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em Design Thinking, Lean UX e metodologias centradas no usuário;
  • Familiaridade com princípios de acessibilidade e design inclusivo;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e traduzir insights em soluções de design;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em São Paulo/SP.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Já tiver atuado com metodologias ágeis;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciadores de tarefas;
  • Já tiver atuado em consultoria ou prestação de serviços;
  • Tiver perfil analítico, organizado e propositivo, com autogestão e foco em qualidade das entregas.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.

This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.

We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.

Who are we?

BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .

What you will do:

  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.

What we expect from you:

  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.

What We Offer

  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.

Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Strategic Projects Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others.

We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

Vammo is hiring a strategic, high-performing leader to join our Special Projects & Strategy team - a small, elite group working directly with executives and founders - to solve the most complex and high-impact challenges in the company. You’ll drive cross-functional initiatives that shape Vammo’s growth trajectory - from fleet and asset optimization to financial modeling, new business models, partnerships, and operational scaling.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, loves tackling hard problems, and moves seamlessly between data, strategy, and execution. You will be deeply embedded across teams - working hand-in-hand with Fleet, Charging, Maintenance, Sales, Software, and Hardware - and expected to think like an owner.

You will be based in São Paulo and will report directly to executives at Vammo

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute high-impact strategic projects that directly influence Vammo’s operational and financial performance.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify bottlenecks, design solutions, and drive implementation.
  • Build analytical frameworks and dashboards to inform decision-making across the company.
  • Develop business cases, models, and strategic plans for new initiatives — from asset financing structures to expansion playbooks.
  • Own key cross-functional workstreams (e.g., pricing, network expansion, strategic partnerships).
  • Translate insights into clear recommendations and operational action.
  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team on fundraising, board materials, and strategic communications.
  • Build and mentor small, high-performing project teams as the function scales.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of total experience, ideally including:

2–4 years at a top-tier management consulting firm (BCG, Bain, McKinsey, etc.)

3–4 years in a high-growth startup or operating role where you owned key projects end-to-end.

  • Proven track record of leading and executing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills — comfortable in Excel, PowerPoint, and with messy data.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize ruthlessly, and move fast.
  • Strong business judgment and curiosity about how hardware, logistics, and software intersect.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish or Chinese a plus.
  • Based in São Paulo, with willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Strong alignment with Vammo’s mission and values.

Benefits

  • A front-row seat at one of Latin America’s most ambitious hardware and climate tech startups, backed by world-class investors.
  • A mission-driven environment where every decision contributes to decarbonizing mobility and empowering low-income workers.
  • Exposure to all areas of the business — you’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team on company-defining decisions.
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you can handle — and grow faster than anywhere else.
  • Competitive compensation and equity package.
  • Health insurance and benefits.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and purpose-driven team that loves to build real things in the real world.

Vammo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or any other protected factor.

title: QHSE Coordinator
description:
About the Company

Munksjö is a leading international manufacturer of decor paper for surface finishing on wood-based panels.

Our mission is to create comfortable living and working environments , always driven by innovation, quality, and environmental responsibility .

We develop and deliver innovative and customized decorative paper solutions , which, after further processing, are used in the production of furniture, laminate flooring, and surface materials for both indoor and outdoor applications.

At Munksjö, we believe that taking responsibility for the future of our planet is a priority — sustainability is at the core of everything we do.

About the Role

We are seeking a QHSE Coordinator with proven focus on environmental management to join our team in Caieiras-SP.

This professional will be responsible for ensuring the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of QHSE systems and practices, with a strong emphasis on environmental compliance and performance .

The role plays a key part in promoting a sustainability-driven culture , ensuring alignment with environmental legislation, corporate goals, and best practices .

Responsibilities

Environmental Management

  • Plan, implement, and monitor sustainability and environmental management programs.
  • Track and analyze environmental KPIs (emissions, effluents, waste, energy, and water consumption).
  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, and licenses.
  • Conduct and manage internal and external audits.
  • Lead environmental impact mitigation and carbon neutrality projects.
  • Develop environmental awareness and engagement campaigns.
  • Oversee supplier and partner compliance with environmental requirements.
  • Lead strategic environmental initiatives (e.g., zero landfill, waste segregation).
  • Support occupational health and safety programs and accident prevention initiatives.
  • Monitor HSE indicators and propose corrective/preventive actions.
  • Maintain and enhance the Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
  • Coordinate QHSE training and awareness activities.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and zero accidents.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Degree in Environmental Engineering, Production Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree in Environmental Management, Sustainability, or related areas (preferred).
  • Fluent English (mandatory).

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in QHSE, with proven focus on environmental management.
  • Experience in multinational organizations, interacting with corporate and external stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of leading environmental projects.

Technical Knowledge:

  • Brazilian environmental legislation.
  • Waste, effluent, and emission management.
  • Continuous improvement and risk analysis tools.
  • Environmental and sustainability performance indicators (ESG).
  • Understanding of GHG Scopes 1, 2, and 3.

Drawing from his Big Four experience, Chad, alongside partners Matt Seu and COO, Kerry Wekelo; built a company specializing in Capital Markets, Mortgage and Fixed Income, and Treasury Operations. Their leadership fostered a culture rooted in gratitude, trust, and growth. Kerry's personal journey led to the development of wellness-based principles that transformed the company's culture. This commitment to employee well being and mutual respect has earned Actualize numerous accolades, including recognition as a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and Great Place to Work Certified. Beyond internal culture, Actualize is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and community impact, and a belief that a people-first approach drives both personal fulfillment and professional excellence.

Job description:

We are seeking a Senior Consultant with expertise in financial transactions, treasury management systems, and accounting advisory. In this role, you will advise clients on optimizing their treasury operations, cash management, and transaction accounting processes, while ensuring compliance with IFRS/US GAAP and best practices. You will work closely with CFOs, Treasurers, and finance teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, from system implementation and integration to technical accounting guidance for complex treasury transactions.

Required Skills:

• Lead client engagements focused on treasury management systems (TMS) implementation, configuration, and optimization

• Advise on accounting treatment for cash, liquidity, hedging, financial instruments, and intercompany transactions.

• Support clients with treasury transformation projects, including process automation and system enhancements.

• Provide technical expertise on treasury-related accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated consulting solutions.

• Mentor junior consultants and contribute to practice development.

Desired Skills:

• Experience in financial services or corporate treasury environment

• Solid analytical and quantitative skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with financial modeling is a plus.

• System/software implementation experience

• Exposure to financial instruments including derivatives, funding, and investments

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting

CFA, CPA, or CTP certification is preferred

English: Able to communicate fluently, you will work with a multicultural team and consultants from other countries.

Contact/application information:

Please submit your resume to . If accepted, we’ll be in touch to schedule an interview. 

Thank you!

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.

Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN

About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.

Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: COORDENADOR(A) DE PROCESSOS
description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

DADOS:

Local: Aracruz/ES

Inscrições até: 31/10/2025

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Responsável pela coordenação e desenvolvimento da equipe de Engenharia de Processos para atingimento das metas através de coaching, feedbacks e treinamentos, integração do processo junto a gestão de rotina e gerenciamento dos ativos da área;
  • Responsável em coordenar e orientar programas de troubleshooting e assegurar a execução dos planos de ação oriundos destas análises, dentro dos padrões de qualidade que garantam a resolução de problemas de processo;
  • Responsável em coordenar junto as gerências de produção as oportunidades de melhoria de processo e redução de custo (aumento de produção e redução de custos melhoria da qualidade de produtos, meio ambiente);
  • Responsável pela coordenação de grupos de trabalhos visando solução de problemas técnicos de alta complexidade relacionados com matéria prima, processo e produto;
  • Responsável por elaborador trabalhos focados em melhoria continua para evolução das unidades e padronização das mesmas;
  • Responsável por gerar visibilidade dos dados e comparativos entre as unidades buscando promover evolução do negócio;
  • Acompanhamento de não conformidades e ações corretiva;
  • Elaboração de balanços que proporcionem visão sistêmica para melhores práticas e ajustes;
  • Avaliação dos processos produtivos e produtos finais, definindo consumo específico de matérias primas, assistência técnica aos clientes visando aumentar a produtividade;
  • Planejamento, Controle e Execução de Testes Industriais, Garantia e Controle dos padrões técnicos nos processos;
  • Participar em projetos de modificações e melhoria do processo, máquinas e equipamentos, por meio de informações, estudos e conhecimentos técnicos;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria constante na qualidade do produto, desenvolvendo novos fornecedores e aprimorando os já existentes, por meio de parceria com o fornecedor e suprimentos;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos operacionais e administrativos referentes a qualidade dos produtos e serviços.

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Química, Produção, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável especialização na área de processos;
  • Experiencia na área de engenharia de processos;
  • Experiencia no segmento de celulose ou tissue;
  • Desejável Inglês Intermediário.

Informações adicionais

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas família, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:

  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental – A Wellz, oferece sessões de terapia online subsidiadas pela Suzano de forma confidencial, além de várias oportunidades de auto cuidado como jornadas, diário de humor, terapia em grupo, entre outros;
  • Plataforma de saúde física – A Wellhub é uma plataforma completa de bem estar com acesso a academias, aplicativos e aulas on-line com liberdade de escolha de atividades.
  • Programa de gestantes – O programa “Bebê Saudável” realiza o acompanhamento gestacional através de contato telefônico e abordagens, além do recebimento de um kit personalizado.

Descrição da área

A área de Renda Fixa Crédito Privado, parte do braço de Asset Management do Grupo Daycoval, abrange a carteira de ativos financeiros que constituem títulos de dívida para tomada de recursos junto ao mercado de capitais. Divide-se em duas macros atividades (ou células): a Gestão de Portfólio e a Pesquisa de Crédito (ou Credit Research ).

A célula de Credit Research desempenha, principalmente, a função de analisar os emissores de títulos de dívida acerca de diversos fatores de risco, dentre eles, destacadamente o risco de crédito. Apoia-se em uma política de gerenciamento de risco de crédito própria, que norteia os principais preceitos para a aplicação da análise de risco e demais processos subsequentes, tais como o monitoramento de resultados dos emissores e fluxos avulsos e pontuais (assembleias, pipeline, documentos regulatórios, etc).   • Analisar a estrutura dos instrumentos de crédito privado;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento periódico da qualidade de crédito dos emissores por meio de monitoramentos de resultados;
  • Conduzir avaliações de aspectos ambientais, sociais e de governança (ESG) sobre os emissores.

Qualificações

  • Conhecimento sólido em contabilidade, finanças e mercados de crédito;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados, como Excel VBA, plataformas da CVM e Economatica;

  • Inglês em nível intermediário;
  • Facilidade na elaboração de materiais e relatórios executivos (PowerPoint e ferramentas similares);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e senso de organização.

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. title: Tech Lead (Conversational Solutions)
description:
Sinch is at the forefront of transforming customer communications, offering innovative solutions that empower businesses around the globe. We are looking for a Tech Lead specializing in Conversational Solutions to guide our talented engineers and help shape our cutting-edge platforms.

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and enhancing our conversational AI solutions, integrating advanced technologies such as NLP and machine learning to deliver exceptional user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of conversational solutions, including chatbots and voice initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Architect and design scalable systems that can handle real-time interactions and integrate various channels of communication.
  • Guide and mentor a team of engineers, promoting best practices and innovation in software development.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver high-quality products.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in conversational AI and incorporate relevant advancements into Sinch's offerings.
  • Ensure robust testing and deployment processes, maintaining high standards of code quality and system reliability.
  • Actively contribute to the team's success by driving initiatives, providing technical guidance, and fostering a collaborative environment.

Requirements

  • Experience performing as technical lead of Software Development team.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in software development, with a strong focus on AI and conversational solutions.
  • Expertise in programming Low Code (Dialogue Flow, IBM Watson), NodeJS, JavaScript, Golang ou outras linguagens microsservices
  • Experience with NLP technologies and frameworks (e.g., Rasa, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of microservices, cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience in leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and driving collaborative projects.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for developing innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  • Experience with real-time messaging platforms and API integrations.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.

Benefits

Sinch is a global company composed of people from different countries and cultures. Our benefits adjust regionally to support employees and help them to thrive in every stage of life. We offer valuable benefits and resources, including health and life insurance, a flexible work environment, retirement savings plans, and more.

  • STAY HEALTHY: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • FLEXIBLE BENEFITS: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • FAMILY FIRST: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • EVERYDAY WELLBEING: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • TAKE A BREAK: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

We're conducting a search for a Strategic Regional Talent Partner with 10+ years of progressive HR experience, an essential and proven focus on the Latin American (LATAM) region, and fluency in Portuguese and English with good verbal communication in Spanish.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.

Key Areas of Accountability & Impact

The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:

1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting

  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance

  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model
  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.

Required Experience, Skills, & Qualifications

Experience & Educational Foundation

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is highly desired.
  • Context: Proven ability to operate successfully within a complex, matrixed global organization utilizing an HR shared services delivery model.

Critical Competencies

  • Bilingual Capability: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly desirable.

Other Requirements

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

  • Diagnóstico e plano de ação para maturidade DevOps: mapear processos, ferramentas e práticas atuais, identificando gargalos e propondo um plano de evolução com prioridades claras para eficiência, automação e confiabilidade;

  • Governança e confiabilidade dos ambientes: implementar processos e ferramentas que fortaleçam segurança, configuração e monitoramento, utilizando infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform), além de fomentar a cultura de observabilidade e resposta proativa a incidentes;

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis ;

title: Area Zone Manager
description:
Neptune Group of Companies is a leader in maritime logistics and transportation, offering sustainable, efficient, and innovative solutions across vehicle logistics, dry bulk shipping, and automotive-focused land services. Honoring its family maritime heritage, the Group combines cutting-edge technologies with its signature “Wake Forward” philosophy, driving adaptability and excellence in modern logistics.

The Group includes Neptune Lines, Neptune Shipping Agencies, Neptune Dry Management, Neptune Land Services, and FERST Logistics , each offering specialized expertise. From maritime transport to land-based operations, Neptune Group delivers seamless, end-to-end solutions tailored to its partners’ evolving needs. In this context, the Group is also developing “NLS Port-La-Nouvelle,” its first dedicated automotive port terminal, located in southern France.

Guided by core values of integrity, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, Neptune Group remains committed to driving sustainable growth and strengthening its leadership across the logistics industry.

We are seeking a motivated and commercially driven Area Zone Manager (Latin America) to join our Commercial team. In this role, you will manage the implementation of sales initiatives in order to promote and sell Neptune Group services, generate revenues, and build client relationships with assigned customer accounts or prospective clients, serving as the main sales contact point. You will also be responsible for growing the Group’s services in the assigned territory (mainly Brazil and Argentina), in accordance with corporate objectives, by providing relevant market intelligence, finding and developing qualified leads, and converting them into prospects and clients.

The preferable candidate will be based in Santos (Brazil).

Reporting directly to the Commercial Director, Key Accountabilities include:

  • Drive sales growth in Brazil, Argentina, and wider Latin America by developing and executing territory sales plans.
  • Build strong pipelines and long-term relationships with clients, prospects, and key stakeholders through regular engagement and business reviews.
  • Coordinate the set-up and future management of an agencies’ network, while monitoring competitors, market trends, and risks.
  • Support tenders, prepare quotations, negotiate agreements, and contribute to closing sales.
  • Represent Neptune Lines at client meetings, industry events, and exhibitions to promote services and strengthen brand presence in the region.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Marketing, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • 8–10 years of proven experience in sales, business development, and account management within the logistics/transportation sector (ocean and air freight, import/export), with a strong track record in Latin American markets.
  • Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (oral and written).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and experience with CRM systems.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Brazil, Argentina, wider Latin America, and occasionally to Neptune Lines’ headquarters in Europe.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities and deliver growth.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Consultative sales approach with proven negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build strong client and stakeholder relationships at all levels.
  • Self-motivated, resilient, and results driven.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.

Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!

Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.

In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.

Nice to have:

  • Golang experience

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
At MTech Systems, our company mission is to increase yield in protein production to help feed the growing world population without compromising animal welfare or damaging the planet. We aim to create software that delivers real-time data to the entire supply chain that allows producers to get better insight into what is happening on their farms and what they can do to responsibly improve production.

MTech Systems is a prominent provider of tools for managing performance in Live Animal Protein Production. For over 30 years, MTech Systems has provided cutting-edge enterprise data solutions for all aspects of the live poultry operations cycle. We provide our customers with solutions in Business Intelligence, Live Production Accounting, Production Planning, and Remote Data Management—all through an integrated system. Our applications can currently be found running businesses on six continents in over 50 countries. MTech has built an international reputation for equipping our customers with the power to utilize comprehensive data to maximize profitability.

With over 275 employees globally, MTech Systems currently has main offices in Mexico, United States, and Brazil, with additional resources in key markets around the world. MTech Systems USA’s headquarters is based in Atlanta, Georgia and has approximately 90 team members in a casual, collaborative environment. Our work culture here is based on a commitment to helping our clients feed the world, resulting in a flexible and rewarding atmosphere. We are committed to maintaining a work culture that enhances collaboration, provides robust development tools, offers training programs, and allows for direct access to senior and executive management.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong customer-facing experience to join our IT team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of cloud architecture, automation, and customer success. You’ll work closely with internal teams and external customers to design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure—primarily in Microsoft Azure.

You’ll play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, supporting SaaS deployments, and ensuring our customers have seamless experience with our cloud-hosted solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong emphasis on communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure to support customer-facing applications.
  • Collaborate with product, development, and customer success teams to ensure infrastructure meets customer needs and SLAs.
  • Lead cloud onboarding and deployment efforts for new customers, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security configuration.
  • Optimize cloud costs and performance through proactive analysis and automation.
  • Serve as a technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on cloud best practices, security, and architecture.
  • Document infrastructure designs, runbooks, and customer-specific configurations.
  • Provide Tier 3 support for cloud-related issues and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and recommend improvements to our cloud strategy.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or systems administration, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing or consulting role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Azure, including Azure AD, networking, storage, and compute services.
  • Must be proficient in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud environments and legacy system integration.
  • Familiarity with customer onboarding, technical account management, or solution architecture.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is MTech’s commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. MTech aims to maintain a global inclusive workplace where every person is regarded fairly, appreciated for their uniqueness, advanced according to their accomplishments, and encouraged to fulfill their highest potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at MTech has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.

Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up , o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Desafio:

Garantir a compra e disponibilidade de materiais, equipamentos e serviços, assegurando as melhores práticas de negociação, otimizando processos de compras, custos e prazos de atendimento a demanda do cliente interno, asseverando o cumprimento das regras de compliance em todo o processo.

title: Tech Lead

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

- Liderar a parte técnica do time, atuando de forma prática no desenvolvimento;

- Definir, organizar e priorizar as user stories, além de gerenciar o board no Jira;

- Realizar code reviews, orientar os desenvolvedores e assegurar boas práticas de codificação;

- Interagir diretamente com o stakeholder do cliente (Gabriel) para alinhamento de prioridades e requisitos;

- Criar e manter a documentação técnica no Confluence;

- Apoiar na resolução de bugs, otimização de performance e integração entre front-end e back-end;

- Promover melhoria contínua, colaboração e autonomia no time.

O que você precisa ter:

- Experiência sólida em .NET (C#) e SQL Server;

- Bom domínio de React e integração via APIs REST;

- Experiência anterior como Tech Lead ou Desenvolvedor Sênior em ambientes complexos ou legados;

- Experiência com GitHub (preferencialmente com GitHub Copilot), Jira e Confluence;

- Boa comunicação, proatividade e capacidade de liderança técnica;

- Inglês avançado;

- Desejável:

- Capacidade de definir padrões técnicos e processos para times autogerenciáveis.

title: ESPECIALISTA LEAN

Essa posição trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras áreas da instalação, incluindo Qualidade de Serviço, Almoxarifado, Reparos & Manutenção, Suprimentos, HSE, Finanças, Operações, Recursos Humanos e Qualidade.
